import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd();rows=json.loads((p/'originals.json').read_text());r=json.loads((p/'results.json').read_text());reserved=json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text())['ids'];assert set(map(str,reserved))==set(r) and len(rows)==20
for x in rows:
 i=str(x['object']['mathdb_id']);assert (p/'raw'/f'{i}.jsonl').read_bytes()==x['raw'].encode()
 assert hashlib.sha256(x['raw'].encode()).hexdigest()==x['raw_sha256']
 assert hashlib.sha256(x['raw_statement_token'].encode()).hexdigest()==x['raw_statement_token_sha256']
 assert json.loads(x['raw_statement_token'])==x['object']['statement']
 assert hashlib.sha256(x['object']['statement'].encode()).hexdigest()==x['decoded_statement_sha256'];assert x['newline']
charges=[json.loads(s) for s in (p/'search-charges.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];b=json.loads((p/'search-budget.json').read_text());assert b['calls_used']==len(charges)==3 and b['queries_used']==sum(len(x['queries']) for x in charges)==9
prev='0'*64;ledger=(p/'guard-ledger.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True)
for i,raw in enumerate(ledger):
 o=json.loads(raw);assert o['seq']==i and o['previous']==prev;prev=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
print('PASS20 raw/token/decoded bindings;20 keyed gates;3calls9queries continuity;12guard events chain intact')
# Source bytes authenticated against actual guard outcomes.
for raw in ledger:
 o=json.loads(raw)
 if o['event']=='success':assert hashlib.sha256((p/o['destination']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==o['sha256']
print('PASS5 saved source hashes. All mathematical status remains author-only/PARK/public-zero.')
